title: The Normative Participle: Obligations and Inevitability
grammar: The participle in *-andó / -endő* as a legal command
goal: I can use the participle in *-andó/-endő* as a legal command (*végrehajtandó*, *figyelembe veendő*).
I can distinguish between a description and a mandatory legal obligation.
I can write a formal instruction with a participle in *-andó/-endő*.

sections.title: Unit 7: Legal Syntactic Architecture & Normative Modality
body: Hungarian legal and constitutional language is a very precise register. It uses the participle in *-andó/-endő* as a command, duty and right formulas, conditions and exceptions.

In this unit you will use legal formulas (*alkalmazandó*, *terheli a kötelezettség*, *feltéve, hogy*, *kivéve, ha*, *hatáskörébe tartozik*) and read a text about József Eötvös and the limits of state power.
